name: abstract-line-poster
title_zh: 任何主题都能落成一张手绘线条海报
tagline_zh: 给一句话、一个物件、一张照片，它替你画出有印刷质感的抽象线稿海报。留白、手写字体、不完美笔触。
tagline_en: Feed it a phrase, object, photo, or idea—it draws an abstract line poster with print texture, white space.
desc_en: Generate original abstract hand-drawn line posters from any theme, sentence, event, object, article idea, or supplied image. Always use this skill when the user asks for 抽象线条海报、手绘线稿海报、留白活动海报、wine/coffee/party zine poster, naive editorial line art, or asks to keep this skill's paper palette, conversational typography, sparse layout, and imperfect print character. why_zh: 它不套模板，而是从主题里提取线条语言，保留纸张色板和手写排版，让每张海报都像独立出版物的一页。
why_en: No templates—it derives line language from each theme, keeping paper palettes and handwritten type so every poster feels like a.
limit_zh: 只输出单张海报的 SVG/PNG 概念稿，不含印刷出血、裁切标记或 CMYK 分色；输入照片时只提取线条结构。
limit_en: Outputs single-poster SVG/PNG concepts only—no print bleed, crop marks, or CMYK separation. From photos it extracts line structure, not original.
title_en: Any theme becomes a hand-drawn line poster
